artifacts.summary: 14-phase plan adding a state-sharing (branching) witness device alongside the deterministic bi-lasso one: periodic share field, branching frame, total_eq_thread, revised (C0)/(C1')/(C2')/(C5) conditions with (C3) reused verbatim, and the deterministic case recovered by instantiation.

memory_candidates.content: When generalizing a specialized formal device (e.g. a deterministic decision procedure) into a branching/nondeterministic one without regressing the shipped specialization, look first for an existing exported statement that existentially quantifies the varying structure -- here `WitnessFamily.Refutes` quantifies the frame existentially. Such an interface admits a second, independent producer with zero edits to the first, turning what looks like a rewrite into a pure addition. Two companion moves make the generalization cheap: (1) check whether each side condition's right-hand side mentions the varying structure at all -- a condition phrased over a shared label/data pool (box faithfulness here) survives the generalization verbatim, while conditions phrased per-component must be re-stated across the new equivalence; (2) encode a per-index equivalence relation as a representative map (`share i j := rep i = rep j`) rather than as a relation plus an `Equivalence` proof field -- the kernel of a function is an equivalence for free, removing a proof obligation and keeping decidability from `DecidableEq`. The generalization's specialization back to the original is typically an isomorphism (a quotient by equality vs. the bare type), never definitional, so budget an explicit truth-transport step.
